label: late original-phase steps (t>=5) in sequences with an early u (positions 1-3)
explanation: Fires only in the original phase at late positions (t=5..8, peaking at t=6-7, mostly the last 1-3 tokens before <DEL>), with a weak tail at the <DEL> step; never in the copy phase or at t<4. Within that window it is strongly enriched when u occurred early in the sequence, especially at positions 1-2; the top activations all have u u near the start (e.g. a u u v o 3 i r). Activation grows with the number of early u tokens. Secondary enrichment for a prior digit 3 and first token a. The early-u predicate captures about 71% of activation mass (dev), but precision is low (~22%): most late steps in early-u sequences do not fire, and about 29% of the mass sits in sequences with no early u. It reads like a distributed code over sequence content, not one clean token detector.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig2=u (+5.19), orig1=u (+4.63), prev_tok=3 (+3.17), orig3=u (+2.94), orig2=v (+2.58), orig0=a (+2.46). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-9.07), phase=2 (-6.08), orig_idx=-1 (-5.47), t=4 (-5.44).
